    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify the complete horizontal and vertical divider lines.
    div_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] and v != 0 for v in row)]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # The puzzles use regular square compartments separated by solid lines.
    row_edges = [-1] + div_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + div_cols + [w]
    blocks = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i+1], col_edges[j] + 1, col_edges[j+1])
              for i in range(len(row_edges)-1) for j in range(len(col_edges)-1)]
    nrows, ncols = len(row_edges)-1, len(col_edges)-1
    # Each compartment row has a color key in its leftmost compartment.
    colors = []
    for bi in range(nrows):
        r0, r1 = row_edges[bi] + 1, row_edges[bi+1]
        c0, c1 = col_edges[0] + 1, col_edges[1]
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0, grid[r][0] if False else -1)]

        colors.append(next((v for v in vals if v != 0), 0))
    # Find the template pattern in any compartment other than the key column.
    pattern = None
    bh = row_edges[1] - row_edges[0] - 1
    bw = col_edges[1] - col_edges[0] - 1

            cells = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != 0}
            if cells:
                pattern = cells
                break
        if pattern is not None:
            break
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if pattern is None:
        return out
    for bi in range(nrows):
        color = colors[bi]
        r0, r1 = row_edges[bi] + 1, row_edges[bi+1]
        for bj in range(ncols):
            c0, c1 = col_edges[bj] + 1, col_edges[bj+1]
